story.text: Every state transition is a content-addressed event — same bytes, same hash — chained from a zero genesis, rationale mandatory. h(τ) is the fraction of history that verifies, and it multiplies into everything: a broken chain voids accumulated standing.
The dashboard recomputes the chain IN THE BROWSER: the tamper demo flips one byte in a client-side copy and the supervisor's own machine — not our server — shows the break.

The same canon discipline seals the contracts themselves: every schema, the probe registry, and the engine interface hash to one frozen root. Three independent verification lanes re-derive it; see [[The Evidence]].
